style.styleTitle: Personalised Layered Front Door Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised new home Christmas bauble, perfect for celebrating a Christmas in a new home with a representation of your new front door. The scene inside the bauble is made from layers of wood, which are printed with your customised design. Select your door colour and door design from the drop down options and then personalise the decoration further with 2 lines of custom text above the doorway. The snowy scene is finished with a little wooden christmas tree and a scattering of artificial snow. The bauble measures 10 x 10cm.
